messages:
tess: Quick sync noticed a couple of CX tickets where people couldn't find their API key during onboarding. The root cause seems to be env var drift + no clear rotation contract in SDKs. Can we pick a small, compatible standard and an SDK-side UX?
omar: saw the same. most errors are unhelpful: "401 unauthorized" with no hint. hard to tell expired vs scope mismatch.
yuki: proposal: canonical env vars = REDWOOD_API_KEY (long-lived) and REDWOOD_REFRESH (short-lived). SDKs should also recognize RW_API_KEY/RED_KEY for backwards compat but log a single deprecation warning per process with a docs link.
tess: agree. deprecation warning should include where it was found (env vs file) and a short migration link. Keep it one line.
ben: on rotation: SDK behavior on 401 should be: 1) if REDWOOD_REFRESH present, attempt a single refresh exchange; 2) if exchange returns a new key, retry the original request once; 3) otherwise surface a structured error to the app. No silent retries for non-idempotent requests.
omar: structured error must be machine-readable and snake_case. Suggest fields: code, http_status, retryable, action, help_url. Example: 
```
code: auth_token_expired
http_status: 401
retryable: false
action: rotate_key
help_url: https://redwood.dev/docs/auth/errors#auth_token_expired
```
Apps can map code -> UI glue.
yuki: add a small runtime hint when request metadata (org/project) doesn't match key scope. One-line log like: "scope mismatch: key_org=acme-staging, req_org=acme-prod; consider REDWOOD_PROJECT or a request-scoped key". Emit at most once per process.
tess: discovery precedence should be explicit: 1) explicit client param, 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY env, 3) ~/.redwood/credentials, 4) platform metadata providers. Document exactly so debugging is deterministic.
ben: SDKs should expose an on_auth_refresh hook so host apps can plug in their own token exchange logic. Example pseudocode in sample apps: 
```
client.on_auth_refresh = async (ctx) => {
  // exchange REDWOOD_REFRESH for a new API key
  const newKey = await exchangeRefresh(ctx.refresh_token)
  if (newKey) client.set_api_key(newKey)
}
```
This makes it clear how to integrate with short-lived tokens.
omar: CLI UX: when the CLI detects a key expiring within 48h prompt once: "API key expires in 36h. Rotate now? (y/N)". For CI add `--yes` or `--ci` flags. Also include `rw auth rotate --dry-run` to show env/config changes before committing.
yuki: retries: cap to 2 total attempts, small backoff, only retry after successful refresh. Document idempotency expectations clearly so callers know when it's safe.
tess: security note: avoid printing key material in logs. Deprecation notices can reference variable name and source but must never echo the key.
infra-bot: created ticket DEVEX-420 to standardize env vars and DEVEX-421 for structured error schema.
ben: next steps: omar draft the structured error spec, yuki write deprecation wording and sample app, tess will compile PR checklist for each SDK.
omar: i'll include examples for Go, Python, and Node showing the hook + set_api_key pattern.
yuki: i'll also add a tiny helper CLI `rw auth rotate --service <name>` in the doc examples to show how ops teams can automate rotation.
tess: perfect. small, consistent changes here should cut a lot of small support tickets. Thanks everyone :tada:
